author: astra
criterion: Silhouette and colours match the reference Link without using any Nintendo asset.
note: Reviewed Astra's rendered captures from source 7af541f (captures/astra-character: 01-idle, 02-walk, 03-run, 04-jump, 05-outfit-back, 06-face-detail, motion.mp4 42 frames) against frame 14 s (Link facing camera B) and 1 s. Silhouette passes: long green cap with tail, tunic to mid-thigh, belt, boots, pointed ears, shoulders now ~1.2x head width, walk/run/jump read as continuous motion (0 gait-phase discontinuities across 42 states, jump 0.83 m). Colours do not yet match, which is the criterion's other half: the skin is cream/pale where the reference samples #be8556 (warm tan) in the 14 s sun; the eyes span ~35 % of the head width with white sclera dominating, where the reference's are ~25 % and set lower with a dark lash line and defined brows; the reference cap has a soft crumpled brim and a fuller golden fringe in thick strands, ours a smooth cap edge. Fix path: skin toward #be8556 (shade #8f6240), iris/eye scale x0.7 and 8 % lower, lash line, brow ridge, 3-4 thick fringe clumps. Re-review on the next take with these; motion itself is not the blocker.
